在无人机升空的同时，林舒迅速在手心画符，按照早就已经熟悉的流程，开始行“收禁法”。

他视野中的世界迅速变化，但令他意外的是，收禁法对那个目标没有任何反应。

从之前的实验结果来看，收禁法的原理实际上是将一定范围内异常的“规则活动”，转化成可见的标识。

这样的转化并不完全、也并不一

黄佳妮嘴上这么说，心中则是拿定主意。若是苗若兰想要这幅古画，那么，就算她并不想要这幅古画，也要改变主意了。

“哈哈，我看你是误会了，不要给我乱加罪名，你母亲的事和我无关，逼迫你，更不是我想看到的，是你和你父亲之间的约定，我只是传话而已，再说你和欧阳冰冰不被你父亲认可，这事情更不管我的事。”郑清美继续说。

“我的意思是，万一我演得太过火了，比如对你做了什么很亲密的事情，你千万不要误会，那都是在演戏。”吕涛解释者说道。

不止是攻击方式上极尽变化，凭借着裕谷区能拿奖的精神力控制，波子意的攻击角度无比刁钻，精准度令人头皮发麻。

等到了翠花姐住的出租屋，吕涛傻眼了，以为自己租的那间破房，已经很破旧了，可没想到翠花姐住的地方，比贫民窟还垃圾。

本来只是来问个路，东拉西扯一大片废话，最终人家不仅问到了路，还套取到了更为有用的信息。

血封低声冷喝，拳影出现在半空，将上空的雀神炎轰然打碎，狠狠地攻击在朱雀的身上。

“其实不能说是神医谷参与了，只能说是神医谷里，有一些人参与了那场战乱。”容哲思考了一下，这个不涉及什么核心的东西，还是能回答的。

洛青柠心中有些失落，还想着为一旁的姚大哥与师傅讨件宝贝来着。

叶开身子又瞬移右边，蕴含着强大力威的右掌，一把拍上召木崖胸口。

那股暴躁的气场已经形成了实体，它比外面的大风更加狂暴，大自然的狂风硬生生的被这股狂暴的气场堵截在外面。

屠诗细想一下，承认大才子说得有道理。在那个时间点，假如甜蜜蜜采取更有攻击性的行动，屠诗纵然能离开，身上也要挂彩——而在唐门中人面前挂彩其实与死无异。

胖虎才刚起个头，一肚子的话还没倒出来，就见秦策自顾自的下了楼，他在房间里憋了三天，现在可不想听胖虎喋喋不休的没完没了。

好像有了孩子，他们之间的关系就能稳固下来，他可以心无旁骛地做好一个丈夫、当好一个父亲……她也不会胡思乱想，听到一点儿风吹草动，就风声鹤唳。

②、紫心草一株，这是制作降低二次血脉解放之时疼痛感受的良药的主要材料，有了紫心草，其他辅助药材就很好找了。

等开门看到右师傅的时候，屠诗又有些踌躇。他总不能傻不拉几地直接问“师傅你是不是妖怪”吧？要那样的话，师傅还不以“目无尊长”为由头狠抽他？

过了一会，星月便发现这须弥佛界中的这些人们根本就看不到星月。

所以昨晚上线后，刘波拼命打工打副本，送信，接任务，干着各种各样的活，终于赚到了50块。

屠诗心里那根弦嗡地绷紧了。对方是确凿无疑的英雄级NPC，就算刀不在身边，空手也能打死自己。

As the drone took off, Lin Shu quickly drew symbols on the palm of his hand and began to perform the "Conclusion Method" according to the process he was already familiar with.

The world in his vision changed rapidly, but to his surprise, the containment method had no response to that target.

Judging from the previous experimental results, the principle of the confinement method is actually to convert abnormal "regular activities" within a certain range into visible signs.

This transformation is neither complete nor uniform.

Huang Jiani said this, but she made up her mind in her heart.If Miao Ruolan wanted this ancient painting, then even if she didn't want this ancient painting, she would have to change her mind.

"Haha, I think you have misunderstood. Don't accuse me randomly. Your mother's matter has nothing to do with me. Forcing you is not what I want to see. It is an agreement between you and your father. I am just passing on the message. Besides, you and Ouyang Bingbing are not recognized by your father. This matter is none of my business." Zheng Qingmei continued.

"What I mean is that if I go too far, for example, if I do something very intimate to you, don't misunderstand me. It's all acting," explained Lu Tao.

Not only are there extreme changes in attack methods, but with Yugu District's award-winning mental control, Bo Ziyi's attack angles are extremely tricky, and his accuracy is mind-numbing.

When he arrived at the rental house where Sister Cuihua lived, Lu Tao was dumbfounded. He thought that the shabby room he rented was already very dilapidated, but he did not expect that the place where Sister Cuihua lived was even more rubbish than the slums.

Originally I just came here to ask for directions and rambled a lot of nonsense. In the end, I not only asked for directions, but also got more useful information.

Xue Feng shouted coldly in a low voice, and the shadow of his fist appeared in the air, shattering the bird flames in the sky and attacking Suzaku's body fiercely.

"Actually, we can't say that the Valley of Divine Doctors was involved. We can only say that some people in the Valley of Divine Doctors participated in the war." Rong Zhe thought about it for a moment, and he could still answer this question because it didn't involve anything core.

Luo Qingning felt a little disappointed, and was still thinking about asking for a treasure for Brother Yao and his master who were standing beside him.

Ye Kai teleported to the right again, and slapped Zhao Muya's chest with his right palm containing great power.

The violent aura has taken shape. It is more violent than the strong wind outside. The strong wind of nature is blocked by this violent aura.

Tu Shi thought about it carefully and admitted that what the talented man said made sense.At that point in time, if Tianmi took more aggressive actions, even if Tu Shi could leave, he would still be in trouble - and being in trouble in front of people in the Tang Sect is actually the same as death.

Fat Hu had just started to raise his head, and before he had finished speaking, he saw Qin Ce going downstairs, minding his own business. He had been holding it in his room for three days, and now he didn't want to listen to Fat Hu's endless chatter.

It seems that after having a child, the relationship between them will be stabilized, and he can concentrate on being a good husband and a good father... and she will not think about it randomly, and get upset when she hears the slightest commotion.

②. A strain of purple heart grass. This is the main material for making a good medicine to reduce the pain during the second blood vessel liberation. With purple heart grass, other auxiliary medicinal materials are easy to find.

When he opened the door and saw Master You, Tu Shi hesitated again.He couldn't just be stupid and ask "Master, are you a monster?" right?If that's the case, wouldn't the master give him a hard slap on the head for "having no respect for his elders"?

After a while, Xingyue discovered that these people in the Sumeru Buddha Realm could not see Xingyue at all.

So after going online last night, Liu Bo worked hard to create dungeons, deliver letters, take tasks, and do all kinds of work, and finally earned 50 yuan.

The chord in Tu Shi's heart tightened.The opponent is undoubtedly a hero-level NPC. Even if the knife is not beside him, he can kill himself with bare hands.
